newsitem.title: USA: Vanstar says Warburg boosts stake to 38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vanstar says Warburg boosts stake to 38 pct.

text.p: Vanstar Corp, a provider of computer network products and services, on Tuesday said Warburg, Pincus Capital Co LP has acquired another 2.6 million shares of Vanstar common stock, giving Warburg a 38 percent stake in Vanstar, or about 16 million shares in total.
In a statement, Vanstar said Warburg acquired the shares for investment purposes.
"We view these purchases as an expression of Warburg's confidence in Vanstar and its future prospects," said William Tauscher, Vanstar chairman.
